representative_scale.configuration: CPU standard, fixed 3600 rotations, 26 OpenMP threads; one serial docking run per case retaining 50 predictions. Four serial evaluator blocks visiting all cases in listed order, one fresh Python subprocess each: exactly 16 evaluations of 50 poses.
representative_scale.hardware_target: One H100 PCIe 80GB allocation, 26-logical-CPU host entitlement; GPU remains idle during CPU docking.

inputs.evaluation_only: Native bound references never accessed by docking command harness. Fixed native and decoy receptor R / ligand L; parallel_io=False.
inputs.CUDA_MPS: Preserve inherited CUDA_MPS_* unchanged; no daemon management.

outputs.retained: All 200 ranked PDB complexes, docking output/logs, 16 full evaluator CSVs, raw timings, failures, manifests and source/input/native/script/binary/dependency hashes. Preserve endpoint values without quality verdicts.

timing_scope.primary: Parent monotonic immediately before fresh child creation through successful child exit and CSV existence/size check. Includes interpreter/import, reading all 50 poses plus native, calculate(), validate 50 unique model_1..model_50 and finite DockQ, serialize and flush full CSV.
timing_scope.excluded: Setup/install, docking/reconstruction, operator retrieval/export; separately time and charge allocation wall.
timing_scope.secondary: Calculation-only wall, docking printed timers, invocation-to-last-pose wall; never replace complete child wall.
timing_scope.timeout_rule: Process-group cleanup; preserve partial artifacts. Timeout is right-censored lower bound, T unknown, allowance failed if evaluator lower bound exceeds 60; never replace completed wall with 180. Continue fixed remaining attempts only within lifecycle budget.
timing_scope.scoring: T=max(all 16 complete child walls); any valid >60 witness falsifies allowance despite later failure. All 16 <=60 passes provisionally only with valid setup/pins/smokes. Invalid/missing rows, nonfinite values, bad identity or timing means inconclusive without valid falsifying witness.

checks_before_timing: Verify raw and all eight generated prepared hashes; capture actual binary/dependency identities and fixed reference correspondence.
Four header lines plus 50 finite seven-field ranked rows; positive actual grid, voxel 1.2 and standard sampling; 50 readable nonempty complexes with expected R/L chains and atom inventory.
Native-self evaluator smoke per case: DockQ 1 within 1e-6, fixed DESIGN criterion, failure stops benchmark.

harness_contract.run_command.sh: Only four serial CPU-standard docking jobs once each, reconstruct all 50 complexes per case; no evaluator import/native access.
harness_contract.run_anchors.sh: Invoke bash harness/run_command.sh exactly once, then checks and evaluator calibration. Empty published anchors remain empty.
harness_contract.stop: External --stop-after-reproduce wrapper must stop after setup/anchors/freeze; no later scientific pipeline stages.
